programmes.programName: PhD in Industrial and Systems Engineering
programmes.school: Thomas J. Watson College of Engineering and Applied Science
programmes.evidence: Official PhD paragraph names supply chain management, healthcare systems, enterprise systems, optimization and electronics manufacturing research. Dissertation, comprehensive examination and oral defense required. Programme hosted by the School of Systems Science and Industrial Engineering within Watson College.
limitations: One ISE research doctorate; online and campus delivery are not separate awards. Named topics are research areas, not separately awarded concentrations.

branches.conclusion: Current university-wide degree finder identifies Management PhD; opened current School of Management doctoral page lists all four formal specialized tracks (Finance, Leadership and Organizational Science, Marketing, Management Information Systems). None has a qualifying Operations, Management Science or Industrial Engineering title. Existing Industrial and Systems Engineering PhD is separate in Watson College.

Opened current university-wide degree finder and the complete Watson College graduate programme inventory, updated June 2026. Industrial and Systems Engineering PhD is the only named qualifying engineering route; Systems Science is a separate generic PhD and its MS-only Health Systems concentrations are not duplicated. Opened Mathematical Sciences PhD details; its named research areas are algebra, analysis, combinatorics, geometry/topology and statistics, not a formal OR concentration.
